_comment: Pipeline environment -> Datasphere space technical name. The SAP trial tenant has ONE space and no rights to create more, so dev, test and prod all point at it: every stage makes real CLI calls on real objects, promotion just lands in the same space. On a tenant with three spaces, change test/prod to e.g. TEST_SALES / PROD_SALES. Hosts and secrets are never stored here (.env or CI/CD variables).
